title: Operation ShadowNet
description: Investigation into suspected trade-based value transfer routed through freight and logistics intermediaries in the Delhi NCR and Nhava Sheva corridors. Focus on the relationship between Zenith Holdings, Apex Global Logistics and an offshore counterparty in Zurich.

title: Operation Golden Falcon
description: Archived investigation into undeclared consignments moving through Nhava Sheva port. Closed for want of corroboration in December 2023. Retained for cross-case reference.
